headline: Seven patterns in four cities
umbrella_statement: Under each project you'll find its swatches, named as you'd order them: the Amsterdam plinths are Salmon Terra, PS2121.
intro:
In the projects below, Polygood was used for display plinths in an Amsterdam department store, washstands in a Vienna hotel, kitchenette worktops in a Paris office and furniture made by a Taipei design studio.

One pattern, Emerald Ghost, appears in three of them: on the hotel's washstands, on the office worktops and among the studio's pieces.

cases.title: De Bijenkorf
cases.headline: On Dam Square, Salmon Terra plinths lift mannequins
cases.body: De Bijenkorf, the Netherlands' premium department store, reopened the women's fashion and shoe department of its Dam Square flagship in 2026, with sustainability in the brief from the first meeting. The design is by Random Studio with the store's own design team, and Fiction Factory built the display stands in Salmon Terra: stepped plinths and blocks that lift mannequins and bags above the shop floor. The store first used Polygood in 2023, for retail fixtures, and chose it again.
cases.application: Display stands: stepped plinths and blocks
cases.image_alt: Stepped display stands in Salmon Terra with mannequins in the women's department at De Bijenkorf Amsterdam

cases.title: Henriette Stadthotel
cases.headline: Washstands for the first Circular Living rooms in Austria in two terrazzos and Emerald Ghost
cases.body:
In 2025 Verena Brandtner-Pastuszyn and Georg Pastuszyn renovated their family-run four-star hotel on Praterstraße, a short walk from the Prater. They call it Austria's first Circular Living hotel, a concept inspired by Cradle to Cradle.

In the new Circular Living rooms, the hotel used Polygood for the bathroom washstands, in three patterns: Sapphire Terrazzo, Emerald Ghost and White Terrazzo. The one pictured is Sapphire Terrazzo, with a white basin.
cases.pattern: Sapphire Terrazzo, Emerald Ghost, White Terrazzo
cases.application: Bathroom washstands for the Circular Living rooms
cases.image_alt: Washstand in Sapphire Terrazzo with a white basin in a guest bathroom at Henriette Stadthotel, Vienna

cases.title: Orion
cases.headline: Sea-green worktops for an office in Paris
cases.body: Aura designed the teal kitchenette where Orion's Paris team meets through the day. The worktops on the island and back counter are Emerald Ghost, a flecked sea green a shade lighter than the cabinets, so the island and counters read as one block of colour. The flecks give the monochrome scheme depth and pick up the speckled stools. Samji Studio, a Paris office-furniture workshop, fabricated the worktops and cut the island top to follow its rounded end.
cases.image_alt: Teal kitchenette at Orion's Paris office: a fluted island with an Emerald Ghost worktop, ring-base stools and teal cabinets

cases.title: ONE DUST Studio
cases.headline: Surface specialists made furniture and sculpture in Polygood®
cases.body:
For our first project in Taiwan we worked with ONE DUST, a Taipei design studio that makes installation art and decorative finishes, including mineral wall coatings. Polygood can be cut, sanded and polished like a solid surface. The studio designed and made tables, chairs, benches, shelves and sculptural objects in five patterns: Maldives, Black Lollipop, Emerald Ghost, Sapphire Terrazzo and Translucent Glitter Gold, which no other project has used so far.

Indoors, the colours sit against the studio's own mineral finishes on walls and floors. Outdoors, in a gravel garden backed by forest, a translucent blue slab lets the trees show through.
